file(GLOB SF_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS source/*.c source/RISCV/*.c)
list(FILTER SF_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "M\\.c$")
add_library(rvvm_softfloat STATIC ${SF_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(rvvm_softfloat PRIVATE . source/include source/RISCV)
target_include_directories(rvvm_softfloat PUBLIC source/include)
target_compile_definitions(rvvm_softfloat PUBLIC SOFTFLOAT_FAST_INT64)
target_compile_definitions(rvvm_softfloat PUBLIC "THREAD_LOCAL=__declspec(thread)")
if(MSVC)
 target_compile_options(rvvm_softfloat PRIVATE /W0 /utf-8)
endif()
